text:
Noah (Finance): flagging an issue from the March invoice re-run — DataForge just reported receiving two invoices with the same id (inv-2026-03-DF-341) and the committed GPU subscription line is missing on one of them. customers are confused. anyone seen duplicate ids after a retry?
Maya (Billing): thanks Noah. which run? sample customer id?
Noah (Finance): run id invoice-rerun-2026-03-09, sample customer DF-341. CSV snippet they attached: 
```
invoice_id,customer_id,sku,description,quantity,unit_price,total
inv-2026-03-DF-341,DF-341,gpu_commit,Committed GPU months (mar),0,0.00,0.00
inv-2026-03-DF-341,DF-341,bandwidth,Bandwidth overage,600,0.02,12.00
```
Maya (Billing): that committed line should be qty 16 and total 512. looks like commitment aggregation returned empty for DF-341.
Diego (Payments): billing-bot log shows duplicate id detected during the render phase. excerpt: 
```
[billing-bot] 2026-03-22T08:05:11Z INFO invoice_run start run=invoice-rerun-2026-03-09
[billing-bot] 2026-03-22T08:05:13Z ERROR renderer duplicate_invoice_id invoice=inv-2026-03-DF-341 customer=DF-341 stage=render
[billing-bot] 2026-03-22T08:05:14Z DEBUG commit_agg got_empty customer=DF-341 sku=gpu_commit
```
Ava (Revenue Ops): DataForge also mentioned a support fee rounding mismatch (they got $4.00 vs expected $6.00) and one invoice had an extra manual adjustment line. could be two separate bugs or a bad merge.
Maya (Billing): dedupe check lives in finalize_output and expects only one bundle per invoice_id per run. retries write a staging bundle and finalize reads staging + previous artifacts; if a retry wrote a partial bundle and the merger ran concurrently we can end up with inconsistent content.
Noah (Finance): customer is asking for an amended invoice and a credit for the rounding error. can we stop the rest of the run from publishing?
Diego (Payments): pausing publish for run invoice-rerun-2026-03-09 now. disabling auto-retry for the generator for this run.
Maya (Billing): immediate action items: 1) fetch s3 artifacts from s3://invoices/2026/03/re-runs/invoice-rerun-2026-03-09/ 2) query staging table for duplicate invoice ids: 
```
SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) as bundles, array_agg(bundle_id) as bundle_ids
FROM staging_invoices
WHERE run_id='invoice-rerun-2026-03-09' AND invoice_id='inv-2026-03-DF-341'
GROUP BY invoice_id;
```
Maya (Billing): my quick check shows two bundles for that invoice_id with different line sets. the dedupe key was only checking invoice_id+customer_id and not bundle content hash, so a second partial bundle slipped through.
Diego (Payments): I'll assemble a corrected invoice manually for DF-341 and issue a void for the duplicate. ETA 90 minutes. will attach a customer note explaining the duplicate id and correction.
Ava (Revenue Ops): please include a credit line for the $2 rounding mismatch and call out the manual adjustment that was added by mistake. also add a customer-facing explanation for what caused the duplicate id (brief).
Maya (Billing): I'll open a ticket BILL-3519 with reproduction steps and stack traces. plan to add content-hash dedupe and make finalize stage idempotent to bundle ordering. PR incoming.
billing-bot: action: publish paused for run invoice-rerun-2026-03-09 by Diego (Payments). ticket BILL-3519 created.
Noah (Finance): good. DataForge asked whether refunds are needed — ping finance if a pre-auth needs to be reversed.
Ava (Revenue Ops): adding postmortem label and scheduling a 30-min war room if multiple customers affected.
Maya (Billing): once patch is merged we'll replay the run on staging, validate commitment counts, support fee rounding and manual adjustment filters, then unpause.
Diego (Payments): manual corrected invoice will include the committed gpu line, corrected support fee, and a void note for the duplicate. sending to DataForge with apology.
Noah (Finance): thanks team. please paste the run artifact links and the manual invoice PDF in the ticket so we can close the customer loop.
